en.name: Pike position
en.subtitle: Experimental shape checks
steps: Sit with both legs straight together in front. Reach towards your toes within a comfortable range.
Place the camera to your side and keep your whole movement in view.
en.focus: Checks describe visible shape only. The new checks are experimental.

zh-Hant.name: 屈體坐
zh-Hant.subtitle: 可見姿勢檢查
steps: 坐下，雙腿併攏向前伸直，在舒適範圍內伸手靠近腳尖。
將鏡頭放在身體側面，讓整個動作保持在畫面內。
zh-Hant.focus: 檢查只描述可見姿勢。新增檢查仍屬實驗性質。
